name: Alabama
climate: Humid Subtropical: High convective thunderstorm activity, Gulf hurricane wind threat, intense summer heat and humidity.
windRisk: High (Coastal hurricane gusts up to 130 mph)
licensing: Alabama Home Builders Licensure Board (HBLB) & Licensing Board for General Contractors.
buildingCode: 2021 International Residential Code (IRC) with local municipal amendments.
permitNote: Permits issued by municipal or county building inspection departments; windborne debris zone requirements apply in Baldwin and Mobile counties.

name: Alaska
climate: Subarctic and Maritime: Severe ground snow loads, intense freeze-thaw cycles, extreme sub-zero temperatures.
licensing: Alaska Division of Corporations, Business and Professional Licensing (Residential Contractor Endorsement).
buildingCode: 2021 Northern States IRC amendments with cold-climate ice barrier standards.
permitNote: Ice and water shield required over entire eaves and valleys; mandatory snow load structural verification.

name: Arizona
climate: Arid Desert: Extreme solar UV radiation, thermal expansion stress, summer monsoon downpours.
licensing: Arizona Registrar of Contractors (ROC) - Specialty Residential Roofing License (R-42 / CR-42).
buildingCode: 2021 IRC / IBC adopted with local city amendments.
permitNote: City building permits required; Title 24 cool-roof high-reflectance shingle standards encouraged in Phoenix and Tucson.

name: Arkansas
climate: Humid Subtropical: Severe spring tornado outbreaks, hail corridor exposure, high humidity.
licensing: Arkansas Contractors Licensing Board (Residential Remodeler / Commercial Roofing).
buildingCode: 2021 Arkansas Fire Prevention Code (based on IRC/IBC).
permitNote: Permits issued by local city code enforcement; Class 4 impact shingles highly recommended.

name: California
climate: Mediterranean / Semi-Arid: Severe Wildland-Urban Interface (WUI) fire hazards, seismic displacement, intense coastal fog.
windRisk: High (Santa Ana and Diablo wind events)
licensing: California Contractors State License Board (CSLB) - C-39 Roofing Specialty Contractor License.
buildingCode: California Building Code Title 24 (Part 6 Cool Roof standards & Part 9 WUI fire standards).
permitNote: Mandatory local city/county building permit, Title 24 cool-roof energy compliance certificate, and Class A fire rated assembly.

name: Colorado
climate: Semi-Arid Highland: Premier national hail alley, rapid 50-degree diurnal temperature swings, heavy mountain snow loads.
licensing: No statewide roofing license; contractors regulated by municipal building departments (e.g. Denver, Colorado Springs, Aurora).
buildingCode: 2021 / 2024 IRC with local cold-weather and high-wind amendments.
permitNote: City permits strictly enforce Class 4 impact resistance standards and mid-roof ice-barrier deck inspections.

name: Connecticut
climate: Humid Continental: Coastal nor'easters, winter ice dams, salt air exposure on Long Island Sound.
licensing: Connecticut Department of Consumer Protection (Home Improvement Contractor HIC registration).
buildingCode: Connecticut State Building Code (incorporating 2021 IRC).
permitNote: Local municipal building permits required; continuous drip edge and eaves ice dam membranes strictly mandated.

name: Delaware
climate: Mid-Atlantic Humid: Atlantic coastal winds, nor'easters, moderate winter freezing.
licensing: Delaware Division of Revenue licensing with local county/city trade registrations.
buildingCode: Delaware State Building Code (2021 IRC).
permitNote: County (New Castle, Kent, Sussex) building department permits mandatory before tear-off.

name: District of Columbia
climate: Mid-Atlantic Subtropical: Summer heat, winter freeze-thaw cycles, historic district preservation guidelines.
licensing: Department of Licensing and Consumer Protection (DLCP) Home Improvement Contractor License.
buildingCode: DC Construction Codes (incorporating 2021 IRC with historic preservation rules).
permitNote: DLCP permit required; historic preservation review required in Georgetown, Capitol Hill, and designated landmark zones.

name: Florida
climate: Tropical and Humid Subtropical: Severe Category 1-5 hurricanes, intense UV degradation, extreme rainfall.
licensing: Florida Department of Business and Professional Regulation (DBPR) - Certified Roofing Contractor (CCC) or Registered Roofing Contractor (RC).
buildingCode: Florida Building Code (FBC 8th Edition) with High Velocity Hurricane Zone (HVHZ) in Miami-Dade & Broward.
permitNote: Mandatory Notice of Commencement, secondary water barrier (sealed roof deck), approved Florida Product Approvals (FL#), and 2-stage roof dry-in / in-progress building inspections.

name: Georgia
climate: Humid Subtropical: Heavy thunderstorms, severe tornado paths, coastal hurricane wind exposure.
licensing: Georgia State Licensing Board for Residential and General Contractors (Roofing specialty recognized under general/residential license).
buildingCode: Georgia State Minimum Standard One and Two Family Dwelling Code (2021 IRC).
permitNote: Municipal permits required; wind-resistant starter shingles and drip edge required by state building code.

name: Hawaii
climate: Tropical Maritime: Persistent trade winds, intense year-round UV, high saltwater aerosol corrosion.
licensing: Hawaii Department of Commerce and Consumer Affairs (DCCA) - C-42 Roofing Contractor License.
buildingCode: Hawaii State Building Code (2021 IBC / IRC with wind amendments).
permitNote: County permits (Honolulu, Maui, Hawaii, Kauai) mandatory; corrosion-resistant 316 stainless steel fasteners required within coastal zones.

name: Idaho
climate: Intermountain Semiarid / Highland: Heavy mountain snow loads, rapid freeze-thaw cycles, low ambient humidity.
licensing: Idaho Division of Occupational and Professional Licenses (Contractor Registration).
buildingCode: Idaho Residential Code (2021 IRC with local snow load provisions).
permitNote: Local city/county building inspection permits required; ice barrier self-adhering membranes mandatory in snow corridors.

name: Illinois
climate: Humid Continental: Severe lake-effect winter storms, spring supercell hail outbreaks, hot humid summers.
licensing: Illinois Department of Financial and Professional Regulation (IDFPR) - State Licensed Roofing Contractor (Unlimited or Limited).
buildingCode: Capital Development Board state code & City of Chicago Building Code.
permitNote: State roofing license number must be posted on all permit applications; Chicago requires strict Class A fire compliance and cold-weather ice barriers.

name: Indiana
climate: Humid Continental: Lake-effect snow in north, heavy spring thunderstorms, winter ice storms.
licensing: No statewide roofing license; contractors registered with local county/city building departments (e.g. Indianapolis BNS).
buildingCode: 2020 Indiana Residential Code (based on 2018/2021 IRC).
permitNote: Local building department permits mandatory; strict ventilation ratio (1:150 or 1:300) enforcement.

name: Iowa
climate: Continental: Severe derecho straight-line winds, extreme summer hail, heavy winter snow.
licensing: Iowa Division of Labor Contractor Registration.
buildingCode: Iowa State Building Code (2021 IRC adopted locally).
permitNote: City building permits required; Class 4 impact shingles and ASTM D7158 Class H high-wind shingles widely recommended.

name: Kansas
climate: Continental Plains: Central Tornado Alley, violent supercell hail storms, high seasonal wind shear.
licensing: Kansas Attorney General Roofing Contractor Registration Certificate.
buildingCode: Local city/county adoption of 2021 IRC.
permitNote: State registration certificate required; local building permits enforce 6-nail wind patterns.

name: Kentucky
climate: Humid Subtropical / Continental: Frequent spring storms, winter freeze-thaw cycles, high rainfall.
licensing: Local municipal trade licensing (e.g. Louisville Metro, Lexington-Fayette).
buildingCode: 2021 Kentucky Residential Code (KRC).
permitNote: Permits issued through local planning and code enforcement; ice barrier required along eaves.

name: Louisiana
climate: Humid Subtropical: Catastrophic Gulf hurricane landfalls, extreme rainfall, high heat and humidity.
windRisk: Extreme (Coastal hurricane wind speeds up to 150+ mph)
licensing: Louisiana State Licensing Board for Contractors (LSLBC) - Residential Building / Commercial Roofing.
buildingCode: Louisiana State Uniform Construction Code (2021 IRC with coastal wind provisions).
permitNote: FORTIFIED roof standards widely incentivized; hurricane strap inspection and sealed roof deck required in coastal parishes.

name: Maine
climate: Humid Continental / Subarctic: Heavy winter snowpack, coastal nor'easters, severe ice dams.
licensing: No statewide roofing license; consumer protection managed under Maine Attorney General Home Construction rules.
buildingCode: Maine Uniform Building and Energy Code (MUBEC - 2021 IRC).
permitNote: Municipal permits required; ice barrier membrane mandatory 24 inches inside interior heated wall line.

name: Maryland
climate: Mid-Atlantic Humid: Chesapeake Bay storm winds, summer thunderstorm downpours, winter ice storms.
licensing: Maryland Home Improvement Commission (MHIC) - Licensed Home Improvement Contractor.
buildingCode: Maryland Building Performance Standards (MBPS - 2021 IRC).
permitNote: MHIC license number required on all permits; county inspections verify flashing and ventilation ratios.

name: Massachusetts
climate: Humid Continental: Intense coastal nor'easters, winter blizzard snow loads, Atlantic gale winds.
windRisk: High (Cape Cod and coastal gale winds)
licensing: Office of Public Safety and Inspections - Construction Supervisor License (CSL) & Home Improvement Contractor (HIC) registration.
buildingCode: 9th / 10th Edition Massachusetts State Building Code (incorporating 2021 IRC with energy amendments).
permitNote: CSL holder required to pull municipal building permit; ice dam underlayment strictly required across all 351 municipalities.

name: Michigan
climate: Humid Continental: Heavy lake-effect snow squalls, prolonged sub-freezing winters, spring thunderstorm fronts.
licensing: Michigan Department of Licensing and Regulatory Affairs (LARA) - Residential Builder or Maintenance & Alteration (M&A) Roofing Contractor.
buildingCode: Michigan Residential Code (2021 MRC).
permitNote: LARA license mandatory; local inspections enforce ice barrier protection extending 24 inches past interior wall line.

name: Minnesota
climate: Continental Subarctic: Severe prolonged winter freezes, heavy snowpack, spring convective hail storms.
licensing: Minnesota Department of Labor and Industry (DLI) - Licensed Residential Building Contractor / Remodeler.
buildingCode: Minnesota State Building Code (incorporating 2021 IRC with Northern climate rules).
permitNote: State DLI license required; full ice-and-water eaves barrier and cold-climate attic ventilation strictly inspected.

name: Mississippi
climate: Humid Subtropical: Gulf hurricane exposure, frequent tornado outbreaks, intense summer heat.
licensing: Mississippi State Board of Contractors (MSBOC) - Residential Remodeler / Roofing Contractor.
buildingCode: Mississippi Building Codes Council (2021 IRC).
permitNote: County/city permits required; coastal wind-resistance certifications enforced in Harrison, Hancock, and Jackson counties.

name: Missouri
climate: Continental: Severe spring hail storms, tornado alley activity, humid summers and freezing winters.
licensing: No statewide roofing license; regulated by municipal and county code authorities (e.g. St. Louis County, Kansas City).
buildingCode: Local municipal adoption of 2021 IRC.
permitNote: Local city permits required; Class 4 impact shingles strongly recommended due to high hail claim frequency.

name: Montana
climate: Semiarid Continental: Extreme winter cold (-30°F), heavy mountain snow loads, rapid freeze-thaw cycles.
licensing: Montana Department of Labor and Industry Construction Contractor Registration.
buildingCode: Montana State Building Code (2021 IRC with cold-climate amendments).
permitNote: Local city permits required; structural snow load calculations mandatory for high-elevation parcels.

name: Nebraska
climate: Continental: Central hail corridor, severe wind shear and tornadoes, intense winter blizzards.
licensing: Nebraska Department of Labor Contractor Registration.
buildingCode: Nebraska State Building Code (2021 IRC).
permitNote: City permits required; impact-resistant Class 4 shingles qualify for significant local insurance discounts.

name: Nevada
climate: Arid Desert / Sierra Alpine: Intense solar UV in Las Vegas, heavy snow in Reno/Tahoe.
freezeThaw: Low in South, Extreme in North
licensing: Nevada State Contractors Board (NSCB) - C-15 Roofing and Siding License.
buildingCode: Southern Nevada Building Officials (SNBO) & Northern Nevada 2021 IRC amendments.
permitNote: NSCB licensed contractor required to pull permits; Clark County requires UV-resistant installations.

name: New Hampshire
climate: Humid Continental: Heavy winter snowfall, ice dam vulnerability, high wind in mountain passes.
licensing: No statewide roofing license; consumer protection under NH Attorney General rules.
buildingCode: New Hampshire State Building Code (2021 IRC).
permitNote: Town building permits required; continuous eaves ice barrier membranes mandated by state code.

name: New Jersey
climate: Humid Continental / Coastal: Atlantic nor'easters, tropical storms, moderate winter freeze-thaw cycles.
licensing: New Jersey Division of Consumer Affairs - Home Improvement Contractor (HIC) Registration.
buildingCode: New Jersey Uniform Construction Code (UCC - 2021 IRC).
permitNote: Municipal UCC permits mandatory; wind-resistant shingles required along coastal barrier islands.

name: New Mexico
climate: Semiarid Highland: Intense high-elevation UV radiation, spring windstorms, monsoonal flash storms.
licensing: New Mexico Regulation and Licensing Department (CID) - GS-21 Roofing Contractor License.
buildingCode: New Mexico Residential Building Code (NMRBC - 2021 IRC).
permitNote: CID state permits or approved municipal permits required; UV-stable synthetic underlayments mandatory.

name: New York
climate: Humid Continental: Severe Great Lakes lake-effect snow in upstate, coastal storms in Long Island/NYC.
licensing: No single state license; regulated by counties and municipalities (e.g. NYC DCA, Nassau, Suffolk, Westchester).
buildingCode: New York State Uniform Fire Prevention and Building Code (2020/2021 IRC) & NYC Building Code.
permitNote: Local town/city building permits required; ice-and-water protection mandatory on all upstate sloped roofs.

name: North Carolina
climate: Humid Subtropical: Cape Hatteras hurricane landfalls, severe piedmont thunderstorms, mountain ice storms.
licensing: North Carolina Licensing Board for General Contractors (Building / Residential Specialty).
buildingCode: North Carolina State Residential Code (2021 IRC with coastal wind provisions).
permitNote: Municipal/county permits required; coastal zones require high-wind fastening and secondary roof deck sealing.

name: North Dakota
climate: Continental Subarctic: Brutal winter blizzards (-40°F), heavy snow drifts, severe summer hail.
licensing: North Dakota Secretary of State Contractor Licensing.
buildingCode: North Dakota State Building Code (2021 IRC).
permitNote: City permits required; full-perimeter ice barriers and extreme-cold nail depth requirements apply.

name: Ohio
climate: Humid Continental: Lake Erie snow belts, severe spring hail fronts, frequent winter freeze-thaw cycles.
licensing: No statewide residential roofing license; contractors registered with local municipal building departments.
buildingCode: Residential Code of Ohio (RCO - 2021 IRC).
permitNote: City/county building department permits required; drip edge and ice protection strictly inspected.

name: Oklahoma
climate: Continental: Epicenter of Tornado Alley, extreme hail events, severe seasonal windstorms.
licensing: Oklahoma Construction Industries Board (CIB) - Roofing Contractor Registration Certificate.
buildingCode: Oklahoma Uniform Building Code Commission (OUBCC - 2021 IRC).
permitNote: State CIB registration required; Class 4 impact shingles standard across residential installations.

name: Oregon
climate: Marine West Coast / Highland: High annual rainfall west of Cascades, moss/algae growth, snow in mountains.
licensing: Oregon Construction Contractors Board (CCB) - Residential General or Specialty Contractor License.
buildingCode: Oregon Residential Specialty Code (ORSC - 2021 IRC).
permitNote: CCB license mandatory; algae-resistant shingles and advanced attic ventilation crucial in rainy western valleys.

name: Pennsylvania
climate: Humid Continental: Moderate snow loads, ice damming along Lake Erie, summer storm downpours.
licensing: Pennsylvania Office of Attorney General - Home Improvement Consumer Protection (HIC Registration).
buildingCode: Pennsylvania Uniform Construction Code (UCC - 2021 IRC).
permitNote: Municipal UCC permits mandatory; HIC registration number required on all contractor contracts.

name: Rhode Island
climate: Humid Coastal: Narragansett Bay coastal gales, winter nor'easters, sea salt spray.
licensing: Rhode Island Contractors' Registration and Licensing Board (CRLB) - Roofing Specialty License.
buildingCode: Rhode Island State Building Code (2021 IRC).
permitNote: CRLB roofing contractor registration required to pull town building permits.

name: South Carolina
climate: Humid Subtropical: Atlantic hurricane landfalls, severe summer thunderstorms, intense UV.
licensing: South Carolina Residential Builders Commission (Specialty Contractor - Roofing Registration).
buildingCode: South Carolina Residential Building Code (2021 IRC with coastal wind amendments).
permitNote: Municipal/county permits required; high-wind shingle fastening schedules enforced in coastal counties.

name: South Dakota
climate: Continental Semiarid: Intense hail corridors, extreme winter wind chills (-30°F), heavy snow drifts.
licensing: No statewide roofing license; municipal licensing enforced in Sioux Falls and Rapid City.
buildingCode: Local city adoption of 2021 IRC.
permitNote: City permits required; Class 4 impact shingles and cold-weather ice barriers standard.

name: Tennessee
climate: Humid Subtropical: Frequent severe thunderstorm lines, tornado outbreaks, moderate winter freezes.
licensing: Tennessee Board for Licensing Contractors - Home Improvement License or BC-21 Roofing Specialty.
buildingCode: Tennessee Department of Commerce and Insurance (2021 IRC).
permitNote: State contractor license required for projects exceeding statutory threshold; city building permits enforced.

name: Texas
climate: Diverse (Subtropical to Arid): Catastrophic Gulf hurricanes on coast, extreme hail corridors in DFW/Central TX, intense heat.
freezeThaw: Low in South, Moderate in North
licensing: No statewide roofing license; voluntary certification via Roofing Contractors Association of Texas (RCAT); municipal registrations.
buildingCode: Texas Department of Insurance (TDI) Windstorm Building Code in coastal counties; 2021 IRC locally.
permitNote: City permits required; Coastal properties require TDI WPI-8 windstorm inspection certificate for insurance coverage.

name: Utah
climate: Semiarid / Highland: Heavy mountain canyon snow loads, low humidity, intense alpine UV.
licensing: Utah Division of Professional Licensing (DOPL) - S280 General Roofing Contractor License.
buildingCode: Utah State Building Code (2021 IRC).
permitNote: DOPL licensed contractor required; canyon wind fastening and snow-load ice membranes strictly inspected.

name: Vermont
climate: Humid Continental / Alpine: Heavy snowpack, prolonged sub-zero temperatures, intense ice dams.
licensing: Vermont Secretary of State Office of Professional Regulation (Residential Contractor Registration).
buildingCode: Vermont Residential Building Energy Standards (RBES - 2021 IRC).
permitNote: Town permits required; full-eaves ice and water self-adhering membranes mandatory by state code.

name: Virginia
climate: Mid-Atlantic Subtropical: Coastal hurricane threat, Tidewater salt air, Blue Ridge mountain snow.
licensing: Virginia Board for Contractors (DPOR) - Class A, B, or C Contractor License with ROC (Roofing) specialty.
buildingCode: Virginia Uniform Statewide Building Code (USBC - 2021 IRC).
permitNote: DPOR licensed roofer required to pull municipal building permits; ventilation and flashing strictly checked.

name: Washington
climate: Marine West Coast / Semiarid East: Heavy rainfall and moss in Puget Sound; alpine snow in Cascades.
licensing: Washington State Department of Labor & Industries (L&I) - Registered General or Specialty Contractor.
buildingCode: Washington State Building Code Council (2021 IRC with energy amendments).
permitNote: L&I registration mandatory; algae-resistant shingles and robust drip edge installations enforced.

name: West Virginia
climate: Humid Continental / Appalachian: High rainfall, steep terrain drainage challenges, winter ice storms.
licensing: West Virginia Division of Labor - Licensed Contractor (Roofing Specialty).
buildingCode: West Virginia State Building Code (2021 IRC).
permitNote: State contractor license required; municipal permits require code-compliant step and chimney flashing.

name: Wisconsin
climate: Humid Continental: Heavy lake-effect blizzards, prolonged freeze-thaw cycles, summer hail lines.
licensing: Wisconsin Department of Safety and Professional Services (DSPS) - Dwelling Contractor Certification.
buildingCode: Wisconsin Uniform Dwelling Code (UDC - 2021 IRC).
permitNote: DSPS Dwelling Contractor license required for municipal permits; ice dam eaves protection strictly enforced.

name: Wyoming
climate: Semiarid Alpine: Relentless high wind speeds (80+ mph), heavy snowfall, severe freeze-thaw cycling.
licensing: No statewide roofing license; municipal contractor licensing enforced by cities (e.g. Cheyenne, Casper).
buildingCode: Local city/county adoption of 2021 IRC.
permitNote: City building permits require 6-nail high-wind fastening schedules and cold-weather self-adhering ice barriers.
